subject: Taxes
title: Crypto-to-Crypto Trades
description: A quick win: understand Crypto-to-Crypto Trades.

hook.text: Swapping Bitcoin for Ethereum isn't tax-free. The IRS treats every crypto-to-crypto trade as a sale and new purchase.

buildup.text: Many early traders swapped thousands of tokens without converting to dollars. They assumed no cash meant no tax event.

discovery.text: Each swap triggers a capital gain or loss based on the dollar value at the exact moment of trade.

twist.text: A trader making 10,000 swaps per year could face 10,000 separate taxable events.

climax.text: Crypto-to-crypto taxation shows how rules built for stocks collapse under crypto's speed and variety.

punchline.text: Swap tokens, owe taxes. No cash changes hands, but the IRS still counts it.

quiz.question: How does the IRS treat a Bitcoin-to-Ethereum swap?
options: As selling one asset and buying another, triggering a taxable event
Only taxed if converted to dollars
